changelog: - **The desalination Template is now a real process example.** Seawater desalination process replaces the small sample: a facility flow from intake through pretreatment, reverse osmosis with energy recovery, post-treatment and delivery, to discharge and solids, in five numbered areas with water, power and chemical lines. It opens on an overview, and each area reads at 100 %. Its numbers are example assumptions, and salinity, pressure and water quality are not computed.
